notes:
PlaneSite 2.0.2: no doubled-up map data on GitHub.
- Publishing a map that's already on GitHub now uploads only the tiles that are new or changed. Publishing the same tiles again uploads nothing and says it's already up to date.
- If most tiles have changed (for example a re-made map), PlaneSite asks first: updating would keep the old tiles in the repository's history and roughly double its size. Replace starts the repository over with just the new map, at the same tile address.
- A publish that stopped part way picks up where it left off without sending anything twice.
